question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: has

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the uses of the given words.
 
 
• Has is used with third-person singular nouns. (He/She/It)
 
• Had is used as a main verb for the past tense of have and has.
 
• Have is used with 1st-person and 2nd-person nouns and with 3rd-person plural nouns. (I/You/They)
 
• Having is used with 1st-person and 2nd-person nouns and with 3rd-person plural nouns in the continuous tenses.
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, "**It**" is mentioned for the Indian Mongoose as a subject pronoun. 
 
• So, as per the uses of the given verbs, "has" should be used in the given sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

Complete passage: *The Small Indian Mongoose, (1) with __its little round ears, is an __(2) agile __hunter and has a long snout-like face and short legs that have sharp claws. It **__(3) has __**brown or grey-grizzly fur and (4) ______ in abandoned burrows or tunnels. (5) ______ the rat-like appearance, mongooses are not rodents.*
